payload.title: Correlations at Sea
payload.summary: This notebook explores the complexities of correlation analysis in paleoclimate studies, focusing on the pitfalls of persistence, time irregularities, age uncertainties, and multiple hypothesis testing. It reproduces a study by Hu et al. (2017) to demonstrate these issues using a paleoclimate record and sea-surface temperature data. The notebook employs various statistical techniques to assess the significance of correlations, considering factors like persistence and age uncertainties. The analysis highlights the importance of rigorous statistical methods in interpreting paleoclimate data.
goals: Reproduce the study by Hu et al. (2017) to illustrate pitfalls in correlation analysis.
Assess the significance of correlations between paleoclimate records and instrumental data.
Demonstrate the impact of persistence, time irregularities, age uncertainties, and multiple hypothesis testing on correlation significance.

section_blurbs.heading: Correlations at Sea

section_blurbs.blurb: Describes the high-resolution paleoclimate record and its correlation with the Kaplan SST dataset, setting up the analysis of persistence and other pitfalls.
section_blurbs.heading: Sea-surface Temperature

section_blurbs.blurb: Explores the issue of persistence in geophysical time series, demonstrating how it affects correlation significance using sea-surface temperature data.
section_blurbs.heading: Pitfall #1: Persistence

section_blurbs.blurb: Discusses the use of null models to estimate p-values and assess correlation significance, highlighting the limitations of traditional methods.
section_blurbs.heading: Null Models

section_blurbs.blurb: Covers techniques for aligning time series data, including interpolation and binning, to ensure accurate correlation analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: Timeseries Alignment

section_blurbs.blurb: Examines the challenges of multiple hypothesis testing in spatial correlation analysis, emphasizing the need for careful statistical control.
section_blurbs.heading: Pitfall #2: Multiple Hypothesis Testing

section_blurbs.blurb: Addresses the impact of age uncertainties on correlation analysis, using ensemble methods to account for chronological variability.
section_blurbs.heading: Pitfall #3: Age uncertainties

section_blurbs.blurb: Summarizes the findings, emphasizing the importance of considering multiple statistical pitfalls in paleoclimate correlation studies.
